mapper.select: SELECT a.path as path, p.code as code FROM sys_permission_apis pa JOIN sys_permissions p ON pa.permission_id = p.id JOIN sys_apis a ON pa.api_id = a.id WHERE pa.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted = 0 AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.enabled = 1

SELECT a.path as path, r.code as code FROM sys_role_permissions rp JOIN sys_roles r ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_permission_apis pa ON rp.permission_id = pa.permission_id JOIN sys_apis a ON pa.api_id = a.id WHERE rp.deleted = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 AND pa.deleted = 0 AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.enabled = 1

SELECT r.id AS id, r.name AS name, r.code AS code, r.description AS description FROM sys_roles r JOIN sys_user_roles ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND ur.deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT p.id AS id, p.name AS name, p.code AS code, p.description AS description, p.category AS category FROM sys_permissions p JOIN sys_role_permissions rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id JOIN sys_user_roles ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND rp.deleted = 0 AND ur.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.category, p.name

SELECT DISTINCT a.path AS path, a.method AS method, p.code AS permissionCode FROM sys_permissions p JOIN sys_role_permissions rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id JOIN sys_user_roles ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id JOIN sys_permission_apis pa ON p.id = pa.permission_id JOIN sys_apis a ON pa.api_id = a.id WHERE ur.id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND rp.deleted = 0 AND ur.deleted = 0 AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.enabled = 1 ORDER BY a.path, a.method
